title: On Cooperating with families on the far bank
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：cooperate　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cooperate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the keeper ① cooperated with families on the far bank in silence, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② cooperates with families on the far bank twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cooperate with families on the far bank at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cooperated with families on the far bank before — a line in the register for March 1956 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Cooperating with families on the far bank in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cooperate without asking for anything twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cooperate without asking for anything at once and never mention it again.

By 1969 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ cooperates without asking for anything in silence every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cooperated with families on the far bank again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cooperate with families on the far bank, my mother said in 1974, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody cooperates with families on the far bank twice over again and somebody must cooperate with families on the far bank in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 合作（一般过去式 cooperated with families on the far bank：1962 年饲养员头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 合作（一般现在 cooperates with families on the far bank：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 合作（不定式 to cooperate with families on the far bank：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 合作（过去完成时 had cooperated with families on the far bank：1956 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 合作（动名词 cooperating with families on the far bank 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 配合（cooperate without asking for anything：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去配合不提任何条件地配合下来）
G. v. 配合（cooperate without asking for anything：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 合作（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 cooperates without asking for anything，而母亲又一次 cooperated with families on the far bank）

answers.why: cooperate 意为“合作”，1962 年饲养员一言不发地合作与对岸的人家合作，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 cooperated。
cooperate 意为“合作”，自那以后饲养员来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 cooperates。
cooperate 意为“合作”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯合作与对岸的人家合作”，此处为不定式 to cooperate with families on the far bank。
cooperate 意为“合作”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1969 年之前就有人合作过，故用过去完成时 had cooperated。
cooperate 意为“合作”，饲养员说“合作与对岸的人家合作这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 cooperating with families on the far bank 作主语。
cooperate 意为“配合”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去配合不提任何条件地配合下来”，should ever 之后用原形 cooperate without asking for anything。
cooperate 意为“配合”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻配合不提任何条件地配合下来（cooperate without asking for anything at once），以后再也不要提起。
cooperate 意为“合作”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例配合不提任何条件地配合下来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 cooperates。
cooperate 意为“合作”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地合作与对岸的人家合作，用一般过去式 cooperated 叙述。
cooperate 意为“合作”，结尾那句是母亲 1974 年的话：要合作与对岸的人家合作，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，饲养员一言不发地合作与对岸的人家合作；兽舍里每一个孩子都说这是头一回。（cooperated with families on the far bank）
多年以后，饲养员仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（cooperates with families on the far bank）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯合作与对岸的人家合作这件事本身。（to cooperate with families on the far bank）
早在 1956 年就有人合作与对岸的人家合作，三月那天饲养台账上的一行字就是证据。（had cooperated with families on the far bank）
饲养员说过，一言不发地合作与对岸的人家合作这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（cooperating with families on the far bank 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻配合不提任何条件地配合下来，以后再也不要提起。（cooperate without asking for anything，祈使句）
answers: In 1962 the keeper cooperated with families on the far bank in silence, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the keeper still cooperates with families on the far bank twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to cooperate with families on the far bank at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had cooperated with families on the far bank long before 1969, and the line in the register for March proves it.
Cooperating with families on the far bank in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cooperate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the keeper cooperated with families on the far bank in silence, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper cooperates with families on the far bank twice over whenever the zoo asks.
Cooperating with families on the far bank in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cooperate without asking for anything twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo cooperates without asking for anything in silence every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cooperated with families on the far bank again, and the zoo remembered that half.
